name: actions
summary: The AP pool and the cost of a list of actions, in AP and in real-time stamina.

speed.description: The race's speed. With it the result gives the squares the actions cover.

carried.description: AP carried into this turn from the last, at most pool.carry.

held_spent.description: Held AP spent before the actor's next turn, on overwatch (Trigger Watch, GD_S17_06); at most what is held.

stamina.description: The cost in stamina for a real-time client: AP times stamina_per_ap.

squares.description: Given a speed: the squares the actions cover, floor(speed / speed_divisor) per move (docs/core/actions.md#how-far-a-move-goes).

available.description: The pool plus the carried AP, at most pool.cap.

held.description: AP left unspent at the end of the turn, held until the next (docs/core/actions.md#held-ap).

guard.description: The evasion the held AP left after held_spent gives, guard_per_ap each.

carry.description: The held AP that carries into the next turn, at most pool.carry.

next_pool.description: The next turn's pool: pool plus carry, at most pool.cap.
